description: Return the annotations attached to an LLM call (records[].id from query_calls). An annotation is a user-authored evaluation (rating / comment / label); each annotation includes annotationText / label / qualityScore / createdAt / updatedAt. Use to check whether a call has human review attached or what past reviews said. Independent of the Pro+ plaintext feature (annotations work without plaintext storage enabled).
name: list_annotations_for_call
